caption: The drawing depicts a square textile sample with a woven pattern. The pattern consists of alternating vertical and horizontal bands in three main colors: a dark blue, a muted red, and a light beige or tan. The outer edges of the textile are bordered with the red bands. The four corners of the square are filled with solid dark blue rectangular blocks. Between these blocks, the vertical sections show a repeating motif with alternating stripes of blue and beige with an open latticework appearance. Across the center of the textile runs a horizontal red stripe, dividing the design into upper and lower halves. The central area, which is bordered by an additional set of horizontal red stripes, contains a geometric arrangement of blue and beige that forms a diamond-like pattern surrounded by triangular shapes, with the motif being symmetrical along both axes. The overall composition is structured and features repeated geometric shapes. The beige background of the drawing paper is visible around the textile sample. Handwritten marks are present in the bottom left and right corners of the paper.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
